cases.name: Shannon Marie Isaacs
cases.about:
“She had five children and loved them very much and always spent every minute she could with them,” said her brother, Shane Crowe. “The lake, hiking…just everything she could do with them she could, she possibly would.”

Shannon Blake described his mother as “beautiful, and she was smart, she was caring, she was loving,” and said she “would give anybody the shirt off her back.”
cases.narrative: On 8/23/2022, her remains were found in a burned vehicle in Elizabethton, TN.
